logp.method_description: The value of log P ow was determined by UV–Vis spectrophotometry. For this purpose an UV–Vis GBC type Cintra 10e spectrophotometer working in the range 200–800 nm was used to record the absorption spectra of complexes in both water and n-octanol. The wavelength of maximum absorbance (λ max) in UV domain was determined for each complex and further used for calibration curves plotted in water. Aqueous solutions of studied compounds having the concentration ranging between 0.025 and 0.05 mM were used in this study. Equal volumes of aqueous solution of compounds and n-octanol were first mixed in an extraction funnel, second shaken well and finally separated and centrifuged. The complexes concentration in water was determined by means of calibration curve.
